exposure: mode of delivery (natural vs. cesarean section)
cohort: All childbirth cases (natural and cesarean section) covered by health insurance at three specialized maternity hospitals in Tehran province in 1400 (2021-2022).
finding: The billing costs for natural and cesarean births at one hospital exceeded approved tariffs, while costs at the other two hospitals were below the tariffs; actual hospitalization days for cesarean sections were shorter than the tariff-covered duration in all three hospitals.
mod_finding: Cesarean section deliveries had shorter actual hospitalization days compared to the duration covered by the tariff.
